# Peak Country Auto Hail Repair & Paintless Dent Repair

Peak Country is a mobile auto hail repair and Paintless Dent Repair service by appointment for Greeley, Weld County, and nearby Northern Colorado communities. The business has more than 20 years of hands-on PDR experience. The canonical site is https://peakcountryhail.com/.

- Live Northern Colorado hail tracker: https://peakcountryhail.com/hail-tracker/

- Public resource feed: https://peakcountryhail.com/feed.xml

Current hail reports come from official sources and may be preliminary. Nearby reports do not establish that an individual vehicle was exposed or damaged. Peak Country's hail pages are informational and are not an emergency-alert service.
